_comment: Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) regional governance thresholds. Quantitative values calibrated to MAS FEAT Principles fairness metrics, MAS Notice 655 operational resilience requirements, and MAS TRM Guidelines AI risk management expectations. To activate: set CAGE_DEPLOYMENT_REGION=APAC_MAS
_regulatory_basis: MAS FEAT Principles – Fairness, Ethics, Accountability, Transparency (November 2019)
MAS TRM Guidelines §6.3 – AI and Machine Learning Controls
MAS TRM Guidelines §9.1 – Business Continuity Management

cbf._comment: Gamma set to 0.55, intermediate between US (0.5) and EU (0.6). MAS capital adequacy requirements under MAS Notice 637 (CAR) are generally aligned with Basel III but with Singapore-specific calibrations.

drawdown._comment: MAS drawdown limit set at 4.5%, between US (5%) and EU (4%). Reflects MAS supervisory expectations under the Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process (ICAAP) and MAS Notice 637 stress-testing requirements.

stpa._comment: UCA-5 (MAS): drawdown > 4.0% triggers block. Intermediate between US (4.5%) and EU (3.5%).
UCA-6 (MAS): max 0.8% of daily volume per order. SGX market integrity rules under the Securities and Futures Act impose slippage controls comparable to MiFID II.
FIN-1 (MAS): maximum 9% portfolio sell in one order. Aligned with MAS supervisory expectations for orderly market conduct.

FIN-2 (MAS): maximum 175ms round-trip latency. MAS TRM Guidelines §7.2 require financial institutions to define and monitor recovery time and recovery point objectives; 175ms is the MAS-expected baseline for AI-driven trade execution systems.

confidence._comment: [CTRL_AGT_001] MAS FEAT Fairness Principle F1 requires AI decisions to be regularly tested for bias and explainability. Confidence threshold of 0.96 reflects MAS expectation that AI systems operating in customer-facing financial contexts must demonstrate high reliability. MAS TRM Guidelines §6.3 require documented confidence thresholds in the AI governance framework.

consensus._comment: MAS: consensus check threshold set to SGD 11,500 / USD 8,500 equivalent. MAS FEAT Accountability Principle A1 requires defined human oversight responsibilities. MAS TRM Guidelines §6.3.2 requires human-in-the-loop controls for high-impact AI decisions above this threshold.

feat._comment: MAS FEAT Principle F1 requires regular Fairness Impact Assessments. Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) protects all listed characteristics.
MAS FEAT Fairness Principle F2: quantitative fairness metric. 8% demographic parity gap tolerance reflects MAS guidance that small differences may be justified by legitimate risk factors.
MAS FEAT Transparency Principle T2 requires periodic transparency reporting to the MAS. 6-month interval per MAS supervisory expectations.
